slides.title: POV: you offered to host Thanksgiving and now it's real
slides.sub: The ADHD hosting plan, no panic

slides.title: Clean only the guest path
slides.body: Front door, living room, bathroom, table. Guests walk one route. Every other room gets a closed door.

slides.title: Pick the menu, then cut one dish
slides.body: Whatever you planned, drop one thing. Buy the pie. Nobody remembers who baked it.

slides.title: Set the table the night before
slides.body: Plates, napkins, serving spoons. Tomorrow-you wakes up to one task already done.

slides.title: Make an 'empty dishwasher' rule
slides.body: Run and empty it before guests arrive. Dirty dishes go straight in, not on the counter.

slides.title: Hand out jobs on arrival
slides.body: Someone does drinks, someone does trash. People love a job. You get to sit down.

slides.title: Guests come for the people, not the baseboards.
Want the calm-house plan for every week?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
